embeds.title: BLHA INJURY REPORT
embeds.description: Injury updates across the NHL. Stories are posted by automation as a headline, a source name and a direct link. Full articles are never copied; open the link to read the source.

fields.name: POSTED HERE
fields.value: New injuries • Day-to-day, week-to-week and long-term updates • Injured reserve moves • Surgeries and concussions • Returns and activations

fields.name: OWNER ALERTS
fields.value: The wire checks injury stories against BLHA rosters. An owner who has opted in is mentioned when one of their own players appears, and only for their own players.

fields.name: MAJOR INJURIES
fields.value: A season-ending or indefinite injury may be posted in **breaking-news** instead.
